title: Viktor Casterwill
summary: Viktor Casterwill was a corrupt Casterwill family member from the 17th century who attempted to steal the Ring of Kronos. He was the ancestor of Dr. Benway, a disowned Casterwill family member.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
In the original timeline, Viktor betrayed the [[Casterwill family]] by stealing the [[Ring]] of [[Kronos]], the [[Legendary Titan]] of Time. [[Michel de Notre Dame]], had a vision warning him of what would happen, but was unaware it was Viktor who would steal it. {{source|The Power of Kronos}} The Ring of Kronos would later be inherited by Viktor's descendant [[Dr. Benway]]. A portrait of Viktor would remain on display in Dr. Benway's mansion. {{source|The Power of Kronos}}

When [[Lok Lambert]] and [[Sophie Casterwill]] were sent back in time by Kronos, Viktor and his fellow Casterwill member, [[Michel de Notre Dame]] attacked the pair when they caught them obtaining Kronos' Ring from its hiding place. However, Viktor turned on Michel when he tried to protect Lok and Sophie but was defeated by Lok and the [[Willblade]], who recognised Viktor as the corrupt Casterwill in the portrait in Benway's mansion. Having now prevented Viktor from stealing Kronos, Lok and Sophie had changed history, stopping Kronos from ever falling into Dr. Benway's hands. {{Source|The Power of Kronos}}

full_text:
Viktor Casterwill was a corrupt Casterwill family member from the 17th century who attempted to steal the Ring of Kronos. He was the ancestor of Dr. Benway, a disowned Casterwill family member.

History

In the original timeline, Viktor betrayed the Casterwill family by stealing the Ring of Kronos, the Legendary Titan of Time. Michel de Notre Dame, had a vision warning him of what would happen, but was unaware it was Viktor who would steal it. [The Power of Kronos] The Ring of Kronos would later be inherited by Viktor's descendant Dr. Benway. A portrait of Viktor would remain on display in Dr. Benway's mansion. [The Power of Kronos]

When Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill were sent back in time by Kronos, Viktor and his fellow Casterwill member, Michel de Notre Dame attacked the pair when they caught them obtaining Kronos' Ring from its hiding place. However, Viktor turned on Michel when he tried to protect Lok and Sophie but was defeated by Lok and the Willblade, who recognised Viktor as the corrupt Casterwill in the portrait in Benway's mansion. Having now prevented Viktor from stealing Kronos, Lok and Sophie had changed history, stopping Kronos from ever falling into Dr. Benway's hands. [The Power of Kronos]

Personality

Viktor had a short temper and reacted aggressively to situations. Viktor was selfish and greedy, betraying his own family's values for the power Kronos possesses. He was also violent, even attacking his own fellow Casterwill, Michel, in order to attack Lok and Sophie.

Abilities

Although he did not use Titans,  Viktor proved that he packed a powerful punch along with an assortment of spells.

Spells Utilized

• Augerfrost
• Boltflare
• Featherdrop
• Hyperstride
• Raypulse
• Thundercut

Bonded Titans

• Kronos (original timeline only)
